sources.title: Japanese Ammo with Misa
sources.en: A Japanese teacher explains particles, grammar and listening in English, with JLPT practice and game-based lessons.
sources.tip: Start with the older particle and N5 grammar videos in her playlists; save the N3 practice and game lessons for later.
sources.notes: Channel page opened via /channel/ id; id UCBSyd8tXJoEJKIXfrwkPdbA matches yt.list. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: uploads 2026-06 to 2026-10-10 (N3 practice, origami listening, Sekiro language lessons). Teaching in English judged from titles and page keywords (kana, N5, N4). Most recent upload is a personal appeal about being harassed online, not a lesson.

sources.title: Learn Japanese with JapanesePod101.com
sources.en: Short vocabulary, phrase and situation lessons in English from a course company; the videos are free, the full course is paid.
sources.tip: Pick one N5 vocabulary playlist and follow it in order; repeat each word aloud and ignore the sign-up prompts.
sources.notes: Channel page opened via /channel/ id; id UC0ox9NuTHYeRys63yZpBFuA matches. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: near-daily uploads, latest 2026-11-18 (N5 vocabulary; also a phrases video on saying you feel sick). English-explained; level from titles. Channel promotes paid plans.

sources.title: PuniPuniJapan
sources.en: Cartoon-style beginner quizzes on vocabulary and particles, with short phrase and travel clips.
sources.tip: After you study a topic, play the matching quiz and pause to answer each question before the reveal.
sources.notes: Opened @PuniPuniJapan and /channel/UCf-4NeJ3ACc0e-md-dPgkbg; id matches yt.list. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: latest 2026-11-20 (wa or ga quiz for beginners), 2026-11-13 colours quiz. Page promotes paid tutoring and free kana ebooks. Instruction language English judged from titles.

sources.title: Learn Japanese with Masa Sensei
sources.en: Grammar lessons explained in English with illustrated example sentences, from beginner points up to N2 grammar.
sources.tip: Search the channel for a grammar point you just met in the app and watch that one lesson; the older catalogue covers N5 and N4.
sources.notes: Channel page opened via /channel/ id; id UC3ZrSg_QdMexvDREPuiCXqA matches. Page says beginners to N3 and weekly uploads. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: two series, latest 2026-11-07; recent ones are N3 and labelled N2 grammar, so top raised to N2.

sources.title: ToKini Andy
sources.en: Textbook-style lessons that follow Genki and Quartet, plus a live N4 kanji series.
sources.tip: If you use Genki, watch the matching lesson video after each chapter; take the N4 kanji series one lesson a week.
sources.notes: Opened @ToKiniAndy; id UCsHzgQRjPzOz_w4HSrNLIVw matches. Page says he teaches with Genki, Quartet and own lessons. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: live N4 kanji lessons through 2026-11-03. Teaching language not stated on page; English judged from English titles.

sources.title: Learn Japanese From Zero!
sources.en: Beginner course videos in English from a long-running teaching site, starting with kana and basic grammar.
sources.tip: Use the numbered lesson playlist from the start, one video per sitting; recent uploads are livestreams, not lessons.
sources.notes: Opened @JapaneseFromZero; id UCxuZNRnlprC70l1bnI0n-XQ matches. Page is from FromZero.com with paid membership and books. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: uploads through 2026-10-29 but mostly livestreams and announcements; lessons are the older catalogue.

sources.title: Natural Japanese (NIJ)
sources.en: Comprehensible-input videos in slow Japanese, each labelled by level from complete beginner to advanced.
sources.tip: Watch videos labelled Complete Beginner; replay one until you can follow it, then move to Beginner.
sources.notes: Opened /channel/UCXo8kuCtqLjL1EH6m4FJJNA (formerly Comprehensible Japanese); id matches. Page mentions transcripts with furigana on its own site; YouTube captions not confirmed. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: latest 2026-05-26, weekly until then, levels from complete beginner to advanced; no upload seen after May 2026.

sources.title: Japanese with Shun
sources.en: Easy Japanese vlogs, street interviews and a beginner podcast, built on textbook-level grammar.
sources.tip: Start with the N5-N4 podcast episodes; once those feel easy, try the N4 street interviews.
sources.notes: Opened @JapanesewithShun; id UCu6sZrHyl4hSS2PvlUo2XZA matches. Page says easy Japanese immersion for N5, N4 and N3 using Genki grammar. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: daily uploads, latest 2026-11-19; also promotes a paid bootcamp. Range kept N5-N3 to fit the whole channel (also listed in the intermediate bucket). Captions not stated.

sources.title: Nihongo no Jikan
sources.ja: にほんご の じかん
sources.en: Comprehensible-input channel in slow, simple Japanese: vlogs, folk tales, quizzes and game play, each tagged by level.
sources.tip: Choose videos tagged Complete Beginner, such as the vlogs; if lost, read the transcript on the channel's website.
sources.notes: Opened /channel/UCdZHET-9_Comx6UaVTSETiQ; id matches. Page name is written in kana; teacher Yuki; all levels from complete beginner to advanced; transcripts on its website. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: daily uploads, latest 2026-11-19, tagged Complete Beginner to Advanced. Range Starter-N2 to fit the whole channel (also in intermediate bucket). YouTube captions not confirmed.

sources.title: Chienowa Japanese
sources.en: Picture-based lessons for absolute beginners, taught only in Japanese with gestures, drawings and stories.
sources.tip: Begin with the from-zero picture series; watch each lesson twice and use subtitles only as a backup.
sources.notes: Opened /channel/UCm0_bMpdJ8966au9PvrNaRw; id matches. Page says comprehensible input for absolute beginners and beginners, subtitles as backup; older intermediate playlists archived. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: weekly uploads, latest 2026-11-15.

sources.title: Slow Japanese Listening
sources.en: Short daily-conversation listening practice at slow and normal speed, with romaji and English translation on screen.
sources.tip: Listen once without reading, then again with the translation, and say the slow lines aloud after the speaker.
sources.notes: Opened @SlowJapaneseKaiwa; id UCbD78bfxT7taUJsTLA2CkKw matches. Page says sub-channel of the creator's main channel, romaji subtitles, English translation, several speeds. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: near-daily, latest 2026-11-18, titles say from zero and N5-N4. Japanese captions not confirmed.

sources.title: The Nihongo Nook
sources.en: JLPT-style listening practice tests with answers, plus learning tips and virtual tours of places in Japan.
sources.tip: Try the N5 listening test after a few months of study; replay each missed item with the answer shown.
sources.notes: Opened @TheNihongoNook; id UCYGUwnflqHJ3MlCAbaggqSQ matches. Page keywords cover N5 to N1. vidIQ upload list fetched 2026-11-20: N5 and N4 tests 2026-11-06/07, N3 2026-10-17, N2 2026-02-08, so top set to N2. Narration language and captions not stated; who wrote the test material not stated.
